items.headline: 中埃签署20余份合作文件
items.headline_en: China and Egypt sign more than 20 cooperation documents
items.summary: 两国元首会谈后，双方签署20余份合作文件，涉及数字经济、科技、教育和交通；今年是中埃建交70周年。
items.summary_en: The agreements cover the digital economy, science, education and transport. This year marks 70 years of diplomatic relations between China and Egypt.

items.headline: WMO：厄尔尼诺几乎确定持续至明年2月
items.headline_en: WMO says El Niño is almost certain to persist through February
items.summary: 世界气象组织预计其未来数月继续增强，全球洪水、干旱和极端高温风险上升；具体影响仍因地区和季节而异。
items.summary_en: WMO expects El Niño to strengthen, raising global risks of floods, drought and extreme heat. Local effects will still vary by place and season.

items.headline: MIT提出双部件量子比特架构
items.headline_en: MIT proposes a two-part qubit architecture
items.summary: 新设计用一个部件保存信息、另一个部件连接电路。模拟结果显示，它能提高运算速度和准确率，但仍处于早期研究阶段。
items.summary_en: One component stores information while the other connects to the circuit. Simulations show faster, more accurate operations, but the work is still early-stage.

source.name: 麻省理工学院新闻办公室（MIT News）

items.headline: 刚果（金）埃博拉病例超过6000例
items.headline_en: Ebola cases in DR Congo pass 6,000
items.summary: WHO称，此轮疫情已造成3000人死亡，波及6个省60个卫生区；多数死亡仍发生在社区，而非治疗中心。
items.summary_en: WHO says the outbreak has caused 3,000 deaths across 60 health zones in six provinces. Most deaths are still occurring outside treatment centres.

items.headline: 哈勃在土星南极看到十边形大气波
items.headline_en: Hubble spots a ten-sided wave at Saturn's south pole
items.summary: 这个十边形结构贯穿多层大气，与土星北极长期存在的六边形不同。研究人员正观察它会稳定下来，还是继续变化。
items.summary_en: The decagon spans several atmospheric layers and differs from Saturn's long-lived northern hexagon. Researchers are watching how it develops.

items.headline: 北交所上市公司增至339家
items.headline_en: Beijing Stock Exchange now has 339 listed companies
items.summary: 今年上半年，这些公司合计营收1385.66亿元，同比增长15.11%；总市值目前约8500亿元。
items.summary_en: The companies reported combined first-half revenue of 138.57 billion yuan, up 15.11%. Their total market value is about 850 billion yuan.

source.name: 北京市政府门户网站（北京日报）
